## Description

Repeated staging-targeted Convergence Full executions against the same pinned staging SHA fail on three concrete browser assertions. This is not the Main Full admission/history bug #4042, nor proof that current main has regressed: workflow code HEAD and tested staging target differ. Preserve the exact pinned target while diagnosing the tests independently.

## Reproduction

- Latest: https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/actions/runs/44668353505 ; event `workflow_dispatch`, workflow branch `main`, workflow HEAD `3d8a56e6d2b77d87cc22efc1e7d510a71b243043`, pinned staging SHA `a9ee14f85bc36a8e7a6195c1ac28efb1c4f3d219`, attempt 1, 2026-11-20 03:31 UTC.
- Job `full` ID `136063085450`, step 14 `Run full canonical Playwright suite at pinned SHA`: 515 passed, 3 failed (exit 1). The `admit` job is skipped downstream.
- Previous same target: https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/actions/runs/44652393706 (2026-11-20 01:16 UTC); earlier https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/actions/runs/44650628652 (2026-11-20 01:02 UTC; different workflow HEAD). Repeated failures are not a single transient runner startup failure.
- Latest authenticated run artifact (test reports/traces; not an Acceptance Pass): https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/actions/runs/44668353505/artifacts/14599368530 .
- Latest log failing tests:
  1. `e2e/tests/browser/images-workspace-capability.spec.ts:46`: Project selector requires explicit successful build bind; assertion failed.
  2. `e2e/tests/browser/project-session-create.spec.ts:214`: Project with no Existing Location empty-state test; previously observed strict-mode ambiguous `No Existing Location` selector.
  3. `e2e/tests/browser/terminal-consistency-faults.spec.ts:1435`: writer overflow replaces renderer and resumes output (#2196); at line 1515 `countInBuffer(page, 'INJECT-PROBE') > 0` never became true after dispatch and retries.

## Impact

Staging Full qualification remains red for this pinned SHA; it cannot be treated as passing regression evidence. Failures occur inside Playwright assertions, not in checkout/cache/runner setup. Three failures may have separate owners and must not be collapsed into one speculative root cause. Main HEAD success on other workflows does not validate these tests on staging.

## Investigation Status

Root-cause hypotheses (unconfirmed):
- Images: build/bind state transition or stale UI expectation.
- Project: non-unique accessible selector versus duplicate rendered option/empty state.
- Terminal: notification-to-renderer recovery/overflow race or test probe observation timing.

Compare source and traces at the pinned SHA before changing tests. Do not increase timeouts, skip assertions or weaken Gates without evidence.

## Fix Direction

Triage three independent failing boundaries using the artifact screenshots, trace and error-context; identify whether product behavior or test contract is wrong. Fix at the owning component/test with narrow negative/positive fixtures, then prove the exact updated staging target with the canonical Full suite. If changes are separate, link individual repair PRs to this tracking issue; avoid overlapping concurrent work.

## Location

- e2e/tests/browser/images-workspace-capability.spec.ts:46
- e2e/tests/browser/project-session-create.spec.ts:214
- e2e/tests/browser/terminal-consistency-faults.spec.ts:1435

## Success Criteria

- [ ] SC-01 Capture precise assertion expected/actual, trace and retry evidence for each of the three tests at the pinned SHA.
- [ ] SC-02 Identify and document the owner/root cause separately for Images, Project and Terminal; link related existing Issues/PRs before repair.
- [ ] SC-03 Verify deterministic failing reproduction or an evidence-backed flaky classification; add negative and positive regression coverage without suppressions.
- [ ] SC-04 Required PR checks and relevant Gates pass on the exact repair HEAD.
- [ ] SC-05 A new staging-targeted Full run on the updated pinned staging SHA passes all three tests; record run/job/artifact identity and distinguish this from main-only success.
- [ ] SC-06 Preserve Fail-Closed staging qualification and no forged Acceptance Pass.

## E2E Verification

- none: track existing failing browser tests; add a new stable test stem only if a missing behavior is identified.

- terminal-consistency-faults
